title: Helpers--Painters, Paperhangers, Plasterers, and Stucco Masons
description: Help painters, paperhangers, plasterers, or stucco masons by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

projection.title: Helpers--painters, paperhangers, plasterers, and stucco masons

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

tasks.text: Supply or hold tools and materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Apply protective coverings, such as masking tape, to articles or areas that could be damaged or stained by work processes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on placement of protective coverings

dwas.name: Protect structures or surfaces near work areas to avoid damage.

tasks.text: Smooth surfaces of articles to be painted, using sanding and buffing tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Abrasive hand work on physical surfaces

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

tasks.text: Perform support duties to assist painters, paperhangers, plasterers, or masons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Fill cracks or breaks in surfaces of plaster articles or areas with putty or epoxy compounds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying filler to surfaces is hands-on

dwas.name: Apply material to fill gaps in surfaces.

tasks.text: Mix plaster, and carry plaster to plasterers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.
Move construction or extraction materials to locations where they are needed.

tasks.text: Pour specified amounts of chemical solutions into stripping tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical pouring of materials into areas

dwas.name: Pour materials into or on designated areas.

tasks.text: Place articles to be stripped into stripping tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.

tasks.text: Remove articles such as cabinets, metal furniture, and paint containers from stripping tanks after prescribed periods of time.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
